summary: Master the essentials of Qlik Sense with our comprehensive training. Learn how to analyze data, create visualizations, and make informed business decisions
lede: Qlik Sense training helps BI and analytics professionals turn source data into validated, interactive dashboards. You’ll practice connecting Excel, CSV, and relational data, writing load scripts, and building associative models with reusable measures and set analysis. The course also covers responsive sheet design, expression and reload checks, and governed publishing to support clear, explainable analysis.
audienceIntro: Qlik Sense is most useful when the people who build, validate, and consume analytics can work from a shared development method. This course suits professionals who need to turn operational data into governed, explainable dashboards without requiring advanced programming experience.
audience: Operations Managers using Qlik Sense KPIs
modules: Qlik Sense Foundations and Analytics Workflow
Qlik Sense Data Connections and Load Script
Qlik Sense Visualization and Master Items
Qlik Sense Analysis, Search, and Storytelling
Qlik Sense Governance and Secure Delivery
Qlik Sense Performance and Deployment Plan
prerequisites: No prior Qlik Sense experience is required. You should have basic spreadsheet skills, familiarity with business KPIs, and access to representative data or the supplied practice datasets. Basic SQL awareness helps but is not required. Coding is not required for completion, although you will write and edit introductory Qlik load script. Advanced concepts such as Section Access, reload automation, and performance tuning receive operational treatment rather than production engineering depth.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
